Klak Limited.note: Klak Limited operates as an independent B2B finance and accounts payable automation platform focused on African businesses.

Redmap Networks Pty Ltd.note: Redmap Networks Pty Ltd was acquired by Basware on December 17, 2025, to expand its AI-driven accounts payable automation capabilities in the APAC region.

Wafeq.note: Wafeq operates as an independent accounting and e-invoicing SaaS platform targeting SMEs in the MENA region.
